title: Claude
author: Distinct_Bet_6629
selftext:
Completely new to ai trading. 2 months in maybe.

I’m trying to train/code an ai agent to help with **swing trading.** 

I’m starting using Claude and have been learning a lot for it. Currently I’ve been using **Alpha Advantage** signal trading tool and it basically shows me whether to buy, sell, hold and the price I should buy and sell at. 

It’s pretty interesting stuff and I’m learning so much but I’m looking to upgrade and advance. Any thoughts or ideas please let me know. 

I’d love to hear from people.

comments.author: AlgoTradingQuant
comments.body: Not sure I understand your goal… sounds like you want a thing to tell you when to buy and sell assets?  Or do you want a system that automatically trades for you?

replies.author: Distinct_Bet_6629
replies.body: Lowkey both. I want to start off where it tells me and gives me reasoning back with evidence and later on maybe have it trade automatically. I want to gain trust from it first tho.

comments.author: mojovski
comments.body: From my experience the evidence and data must be ready so AI can do some structuring and eventually reasoning. So I use a knowledge hub to let AI build a deterministic strategy that operates on live feeds.

comments.author: DeFiNomad1007
comments.body:
Any reason why specifically claude vs perhaps AIs that are built for this specific purpose?

Is it more a trust thing? Or do no such tools exist?

replies.author: FreshPlot875
replies.body: I think building one with Claude is honestly just a better way to learn. Those pre built ones are black boxes. If the market trend changes and the bot starts tanking, you cant fix it because you dont know how it works.

replies.author: Distinct_Bet_6629
replies.body: Yeah honestly kinda just this. I’m learning at the same time using Claude, I ask questions about “why or what, or how” all the time and it breaks it down for me. I have zero experience in stocks and I’m learning a lot.
